So I’m going to take a little rest when I get home, if the Lord willing. But we are certainly thankful to be here in Switzerland among you fine people. I believe of everywhere I’ve ever traveled, I have never seen nicer people than I’ve met in Switzerland. That is true. I mean that. I didn’t have to say it, but I mean it from my heart. But we trust that the Lord will bless you mightily, and I hope I will be just as much blessing to you as you have been to me.
